spoofScenario.detail: DMARC is in monitor mode, so spoofed mail is not explicitly blocked by policy. A direct impersonation attempt may still reach finance, payroll, or vendor-facing inboxes depending on the receiver.

recommendations: Move DMARC from p=none to a phased quarantine/reject enforcement plan.
Tighten SPF with a stronger all mechanism and reduce risky lookups.
Confirm DKIM is enabled for the actual mail platform and document the selector.
Review cannabis-specific BEC exposure: vendor payments, payroll changes, and wholesale invoices.

warnings: DMARC is monitoring only (p=none). Spoofed mail is not instructed to be blocked.
SPF uses softfail (~all). That is useful during rollout but weaker for enforcement.
